Interest rate developments applied by credit institutions in August 2026

25/09/2026 at 11:21 (GMT)

State Bank of Vietnam has just released the interest rate developments of credit institutions in August 2026.

For terms between six months and 12 months, rates averaged 6.5% to 8.0% per annum.

VND Lending: The average lending interest rates for both new loans and outstanding balances in VND fell within the range of 8.4% to 10.7% per annum. The favorable rate for short-term loans to priority sectors and areas, which averaged 3.9% per annum.
